statement: Clean no-holder Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 native Wiimote motionplus comparison with caller EEPROM and synthetic imported MP/Nunchuk calibration passes the base EEPROM read. No native extension calibration read occurs; repeated initialization/status/report-mode activity continues, with both success and error 7 replies at identity offset FA. Decoded application motion remains unobserved; no physical calibration, accurate rate, whole-controller or wrong-bank-defect claim follows. No companion event holder exists at each arm preflight and the runner opens none; this does not unbind the kernel driver or isolate its protocol output.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Clean no-holder preflight, kernel remains bound. Correct delivered calibration is distinct from decoded motion; no physical, calibrated-rate, radio or game promotion.
